faq: Do you approve refunds on my behalf?
Only inside your written policy. If a case is outside it, we send it to you with a short note and wait for your decision before giving any money back.
Do you have access to my payment account?
No. Refunds are recorded through your store admin as staff, so the money moves from your payment provider as normal. We never see your bank details.
Can you reduce the number of returns?
We can look for patterns, such as sizing or product detail problems, and recommend page changes. We cannot promise a lower return rate, but you will see the reasons clearly.
Will customers know it is not you?
We write in your voice and sign off with your store name, or the name you choose. We follow your tone and never make promises you have not approved.

desc:
Returns and refunds handling for stores keeps a return from becoming a lost customer. Ecom Swift LLC checks each request against your policy, prepares labels, records refunds or exchanges and sends clear updates from first message to closed case.

## What does returns and refunds handling cover?

It covers every step after a customer says they want to send something back: reading the request, checking it against your return policy, giving instructions or a label, receiving the goods, recording the refund or exchange and telling the customer what happened. It also covers putting returned stock back on the shelf.

Each step has a place where it can go wrong, and the customer feels each one. The work is mostly about being fast, fair and clear.

## Why returns need a process

Returns arrive at awkward moments and they carry emotion. A buyer who is unhappy writes quickly and expects a quick reply. Without a process, the owner answers each case from scratch, applies the policy unevenly and forgets to update the stock count or the customer.

A defined flow protects both sides. The customer knows what happens next, and you know what each return costs and why it happened.

## How good returns handling affects loyalty and margin

A smooth return can be the thing that brings a customer back. Shoppers are more willing to order when they trust that returning an item will be easy and polite. A clear returns page also answers a question many buyers have before they purchase.

Returns data is useful in itself. When reasons are tracked, you see whether a product runs small, arrives damaged or looks different from its photos. Fixing the cause with a better size guide or description lowers future returns and protects margin.

## What a good returns setup includes

- A returns page that states what can be returned, by when and how.
- Policy wording that is plain and consistent across the store.
- A return request form that collects order number, item and reason.
- Reply templates in your voice for each stage.
- Return labels or instructions prepared for each case.
- Refund and exchange records entered in your store.
- Stock updated when returned items are accepted.
- Exchange steps written down.
- A record of return reasons, and a report on trends and costs.

## What we do

We read your current policy and compare it with how customers actually ask. We tidy the wording on your returns page, and we write reply templates for requests, approvals, refusals and refund confirmations.

For each case, we check it against your policy, prepare the label or instructions and send the customer an update. When the goods arrive, we record the refund or exchange in your store admin and adjust stock. Cases that fall outside your policy are passed to you with a short summary and a suggested answer, and the decision stays with you.

The Basic, Standard and Premium packages differ in the number of cases and in what we build, from templates and a returns page to a request form, label setup and an app for tracking. In the largest package, we also review your policy and product information to find ways to reduce returns.

We cannot promise fewer returns. We can show you why they happen and where changes would help.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Write your policy in short, plain sentences.
- Offer an exchange where it suits the customer and you.
- Reply on the same day when you can.
- Track the reason for every return.
- Tell customers when the refund has been issued.

**Avoid:**
- Making customers ask twice for instructions.
- Refusing without explaining the reason.
- Issuing refunds before the goods are checked, unless your policy says so.
- Forgetting to restock accepted items.
- Hiding the returns page in the footer.

## Who this is for

This suits a fashion or footwear store, where sizing leads to many exchanges. It suits a seller whose return emails take over the inbox after a sale. It also suits a new store that has not yet written down how returns should work.

## What we need from you

Send your return policy, your usual reply wording and the address where returns should go. Add us as a staff or collaborator user who can view orders and record refunds, and let us know the limit of what we may approve. We do not need payment account logins or passwords.
